activities.name: The Ridge
activities.description: An open space beside Mall Road, with colonial-era landmarks and views toward the Himalayan ranges.

access.details: The official description calls it an open space but does not document step-free routes, gradients, seating, or accessible toilets.

activities.familyNotes: The source identifies an open public space and landmarks; child-specific facilities, crowd conditions, and access details are not established.
limitations: No current opening, crowd, weather, or accessibility information verified.

activities.name: Army Heritage Museum, Annandale
activities.description: A museum about the Army's heritage, traditions, and history, with an experience centre described by Himachal Tourism.

access.details: The official page gives location and transport information but does not confirm step-free entry, internal access, or accessible toilets.

activities.familyNotes: The page describes a virtual-reality weapons experience. Age guidance, supervision requirements, and suitability for individual children are not specified; check with the museum before visiting.
limitations: Approximately 5 km from Old Bus Stand per source; current hours, transport, admission, and experience-centre availability were not verified.

activities.name: Gaiety Theatre
activities.description: A heritage theatre whose slate roofline is among the landmarks on The Ridge, according to Himachal Tourism.

access.details: The page identifies the theatre as a Ridge landmark but does not establish current interior access, step-free routes, seating, or accessible toilets.

activities.familyNotes: The official source establishes its heritage landmark status, not child facilities or whether visitors can enter the theatre. Verify current access before planning an interior visit.
limitations: Current visitor access, performances, hours, admission, and accessibility were not verified.

activities.name: Craignano Nature Park
activities.description: A nature park outside Shimla with a tulip garden that Himachal Tourism says blooms around March and April.

access.details: The official page does not describe paths, gradients, steps, accessible toilets, or current park conditions.

activities.familyNotes: The source describes a nature park and seasonal garden; child facilities and route suitability are unknown.
limitations: Listed as 16 km from Shimla on the official page; transport, opening status, and current tulip bloom were not verified.

activities.name: Naldehra
activities.description: A meadow surrounded by deodar forest, with a golf course and an uphill nature walk described by Himachal Tourism.

access.details: The described nature walk goes uphill. The page does not document step-free access or the route's gradient and surface.

activities.familyNotes: The uphill walk may not suit every child or visitor. The official source does not give age guidance or route difficulty beyond saying it traverses uphill.
limitations: Listed as 23 km from Shimla; transport, course access, opening status, and current trail conditions were not verified.

activities.name: Shali Tibba Temple
activities.description: A hilltop temple dedicated to Bhima Kali, described by Himachal Tourism as offering wide views of surrounding peaks and valleys.

access.details: The official page says the temple is reached by a gruelling uphill trek from Khatnol village; it does not describe steps or a step-free route.

activities.familyNotes: The official description calls the uphill trek gruelling. Do not assume it is suitable for children or visitors with limited mobility; assess fitness and conditions before choosing it.
limitations: The route and transport details are limited; listed as 45 km by road from Shimla to Khatnol. No current trail, weather, or temple operating information verified.

activities.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
activities.description: Baroque church built by the Jesuits in 1594 that houses the mortal remains of St Francis Xavier; part of the Old Goa area that Incredible India describes as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: A place of worship; visitor rules, crowding and facilities for children or elders are not stated.
limitations: Goa is a state, not one town: travel time from the chosen hotel is unknown, so this is marked as a separate outing that needs consent.
Current opening hours, dress rules and access were not verified.

activities.name: Fontainhas and São Tomé heritage quarter
activities.description: Old residential quarters of Panaji between Ourem Creek and Altinho Hill, built on reclaimed land in the 19th century, with painted tile-roofed houses and taverns.

access.details: The source describes streets and houses but not pavement condition, gradients or step-free routes.

activities.familyNotes: A neighbourhood walk; suitability depends on walking ability, which the source does not assess.
limitations: Goa is a state, not one town: travel time from the chosen hotel is unknown, so this is marked as a separate outing that needs consent.
No route length, walking time or toilet information is given.

activities.name: Fort Aguada
activities.description: Fort built in 1612 against the Marathas and the Dutch, with a 1630 church of St Lawrence and an 1864 lighthouse; some buildings now house the state prison.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: Which parts are open to visitors is not stated; check before planning a family visit.
limitations: Goa is a state, not one town: travel time from the chosen hotel is unknown, so this is marked as a separate outing that needs consent.
Visitor access, hours and fees were not verified.

activities.name: Chapora Fort
activities.description: Ruined red laterite Portuguese fort from 1717 on top of a hill at the northern tip of Big Vagator Beach; its ramparts give sweeping coastal views.

access.details: The fort is described as on top of a hill. The source does not describe the approach path, steps or gradient.

activities.familyNotes: Hilltop ruins; do not assume an easy approach for elders or young children until checked.
limitations: Goa is a state, not one town: travel time from the chosen hotel is unknown, so this is marked as a separate outing that needs consent.
Approach route and current condition of the ruins were not verified.

activities.name: Mapusa Friday market
activities.description: Weekly Friday market in North Goa's largest town, selling dried fish, spices, chillies, vinegar, local toddy, Goan sausages and cashew nuts.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: A market setting; crowd levels and facilities are not stated.
limitations: Goa is a state, not one town: travel time from the chosen hotel is unknown, so this is marked as a separate outing that needs consent.
The source describes a Friday market; current timings were not verified.

activities.name: Patnem Beach
activities.description: Beach south of Palolem beyond Colomb Bay, described by Incredible India as less pretty but much quieter than Palolem, with beach huts.

access.details: The source does not describe beach access paths, ramps or steps.

activities.familyNotes: Quietness is the source's comparison with Palolem, not a measured crowd level. Water safety and lifeguards are not stated.
limitations: Goa is a state, not one town: travel time from the chosen hotel is unknown, so this is marked as a separate outing that needs consent.
Swimming conditions, lifeguards and facilities were not verified.

activities.name: City Palace
activities.description: Palace complex on a hill above the lake with courtyards, pavilions, terraces and hanging gardens, entered through the triple-arched Tripolia gate.

access.details: The source says the palace towers over the lake on a hill; it does not describe ramps, internal stairs or lifts.

activities.familyNotes: Large historic complex; internal stairs and walking distances are unknown, so plan rest breaks.
limitations: Hours, admission and internal accessibility were not verified.

activities.name: Lake Pichola boat ride
activities.description: Lake containing the Jagniwas and Jagmandir islands, with the City Palace on its eastern bank; Rajasthan Tourism mentions a sunset boat ride with views of the lake and palace.

access.details: The source does not describe jetty steps, boarding arrangements or life jackets.

activities.familyNotes: Boarding a boat may involve steps; age rules and safety equipment are not stated.
limitations: Operator, timings, fares and boarding access were not verified.

activities.name: Fateh Sagar Lake
activities.description: Lake surrounded by hills with three islands, including Nehru Island, a park with a water-jet fountain, and the Udaipur Solar Observatory; the islands can be visited by motorboat.

access.details: The source does not describe lakeside paths, ramps or boat boarding access.

activities.familyNotes: The source mentions a public park island; play facilities and supervision rules are not stated.
limitations: Boat operation, timings and fares were not verified.

activities.name: Bagore-ki-Haveli
activities.description: 18th-century mansion by Lake Pichola with over a hundred rooms displaying costumes and modern art, and glass and mirror interiors.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: A large historic mansion; whether rooms are linked by stairs is not stated by the source.
limitations: Hours, admission and accessibility were not verified.

activities.name: Saheliyon-ki-Bari
activities.description: Garden built by Maharana Sangram Singh II with marble elephants, fountains, kiosks, a lotus pool and a small museum.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: Gardens may suit a slower pace, but paths and seating are not described.
limitations: The source does not give its distance from the old city, so it is treated as a separate outing.
Hours and fees were not verified.

activities.name: Shilpgram
activities.area: 7 km west of Udaipur, near Fateh Sagar
activities.description: Rural arts and crafts complex over 70 acres, conceived as a living museum of folk and tribal lifestyles; Rajasthan Tourism lists a ten-day Shilpgram Festival from 21 to 30 December.

access.details: A 70-acre site; the source does not describe paths, internal distances or seating.

activities.familyNotes: Large open site; walking distances inside are unknown.
limitations: Festival dates are as stated by the source; this year's schedule was not verified.
Hours and admission were not verified.

activities.name: Ahar Museum
activities.description: Small museum near a cluster of cenotaphs of the Maharanas of Mewar, with earthen pottery, sculptures and archaeological finds, some dating to 1700 BC.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: A lesser-known small museum; visitor numbers and facilities are not stated.
limitations: The source does not give its distance from the city centre, so it is treated as a separate outing.
Hours and admission were not verified.

activities.name: Udai Sagar Lake
activities.description: Lake created by a dam on the river Berach, begun in 1559 by Maharana Udai Singh; about 4 km long and 2.5 km wide.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: An outlying lake; visitor facilities are not described.
limitations: Road access, viewpoints and facilities were not verified.

activities.name: Chinese fishing nets, Fort Kochi
activities.description: Shore-operated fishing nets that Kerala Tourism says have stood for over five centuries along the Fort Kochi waterfront.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: Viewed from the shore; footing near the water is not described.
limitations: Fort Kochi is listed 10 km from Ernakulam town; travel time from the chosen hotel is unknown.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: Interior stairs and exhibits are not described by the source.

access.details: The source does not describe paths, ramps or the beach surface.

activities.name: Kerala Kathakali Centre

activities.name: KTDC village backwater canal tour
activities.description: Country-boat tour run by the state-owned KTDC through canals linking the city with villages; Kerala Tourism says all KTDC trips start at Sea Lord Jetty on Marine Drive.

access.details: The source does not describe boarding steps, seating or life jackets.

activities.familyNotes: Boat boarding and trip length are unknown; check before taking elders or young children.

activities.name: Tsukiji Outer Market
activities.description: Food market of around 460 shops selling fresh sushi, seafood, seasonings and kitchenware, within walking distance of Ginza.

access.details: GO TOKYO lists facility icons (such as wheelchair ramp, elevator, multi-purpose toilet) for this spot. Icons do not establish a continuous step-free route through the site. The market is full of narrow alleyways.

activities.familyNotes: GO TOKYO advises visiting in small groups because of narrow alleys; eating while walking is not allowed.
limitations: Source says it is liveliest 9:00-13:00 and closed Wednesdays, Sundays and national holidays; check current days.
Most stores are cash only per the source.

activities.name: Hama-rikyu Gardens
activities.description: Edo-period garden on Tokyo Bay whose pond takes in seawater, with the Nakajima teahouse serving matcha.

access.details: GO TOKYO lists facility icons (such as wheelchair ramp, elevator, multi-purpose toilet) for this spot. Icons do not establish a continuous step-free route through the site.

activities.familyNotes: A strolling garden; seating and path surfaces are not described.
limitations: GO TOKYO lists it 7 minutes on foot from Shiodome Station; walking time inside the garden is not given.

activities.name: Meiji Jingu Shrine
activities.description: Shrine honouring Emperor Meiji and Empress Shoken within about 70 hectares of forest, reached by a walking path through the trees.

access.details: GO TOKYO lists facility icons (such as wheelchair ramp, elevator, multi-purpose toilet) for this spot. Icons do not establish a continuous step-free route through the site. The shrine is reached by a forest walking path whose length is not given.

activities.familyNotes: The approach path length is not stated; plan for walking.
limitations: Opening hours were not verified.

activities.name: Yanaka Ginza shopping street
activities.description: Traditional shotengai shopping street of small independent shops selling ready-to-eat food, tea and handmade wagashi sweets.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: A street of small shops; crowding is not described.
limitations: GO TOKYO says it is a short walk from Nippori Station; exact walking time is not given.

activities.name: Sunamachi Ginza shopping district
activities.description: A 670-metre shopping street of family-run food stalls and small shops, described as a less high-tech, local side of Tokyo.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: A lesser-known local street; the source says it is some distance from the nearest station.
limitations: Walking distance from Nishi-ojima Station is described only as some distance.

activities.name: Showa Kinen Park
activities.description: National government park of 180 hectares about thirty minutes outside central Tokyo, with natural play areas for children, flower fields, cycling paths and paddleboats.

access.details: GO TOKYO lists facility icons (such as wheelchair ramp, elevator, multi-purpose toilet) for this spot. Icons do not establish a continuous step-free route through the site. GO TOKYO also lists wheelchair and stroller loan.

activities.familyNotes: The source describes children's play areas; age guidance and supervision rules are not stated.
limitations: Thirty minutes is travel time from central Tokyo, not walking time.
Hours and admission were not verified.

activities.name: Gardens by the Bay
activities.description: Gardens with the Flower Dome glass greenhouse, the Cloud Forest with an indoor waterfall, and Supertrees that host a daily light-and-sound show.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating. The OCBC Skyway is an aerial walkway between Supertrees.

activities.familyNotes: Large site; distances between attractions are not given.
limitations: Tickets, hours and closures were not verified.

activities.name: Chinatown Complex Food Centre
activities.description: Described by Visit Singapore as Singapore's largest food centre, including Michelin Bib Gourmand-awarded hawker stalls and halal options.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: Busy hawker setting; seating availability is not stated.

activities.name: Chinatown Heritage Centre
activities.description: Museum rebuilt from the memories of early residents of Chinatown shophouses, telling their stories.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: Whether exhibits span several floors is not stated by the source.
limitations: Hours and admission were not verified.

activities.name: Sri Mariamman Temple
activities.description: Singapore's oldest Hindu temple, known for ornate carvings.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: A place of worship; visitor rules are not stated by the source.
limitations: Hours were not verified.

activities.name: Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve
activities.description: Wetland and mangrove reserve, Singapore's first ASEAN Heritage Park and an important site for migratory birds.

access.details: The source does not describe step-free boardwalks. It warns some areas close when flooded by high tides or bad weather.

activities.familyNotes: An outlying nature reserve; NParks says Platform 1 is closed for upgrading until 23 October 2026.
limitations: Reached by bus 925 or 925M from Kranji MRT per NParks; journey time not given.
Check flood closure notices before visiting.

activities.name: Pulau Ubin
activities.description: Island with rustic village landscapes and cycling trails, named by Visit Singapore among lesser-known green spaces loved by locals.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating. Reaching the island requires a separate crossing that the source does not describe.

activities.familyNotes: An island outing; the crossing, terrain and facilities are not described.
limitations: Ferry access, timings and island facilities were not verified.

activities.name: Kathmandu Durbar Square
activities.description: Old royal square with palaces, courtyards and more than 50 temples, including Hanuman Dhoka, the Kumari Ghar and the Taleju Temple.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: Nepal Tourism Board says most of the palace premises are open all week, but the Taleju Temple opens only one day a year.
limitations: Entry fees apply for foreign nationals per NTB; current rates and hours were not verified.

activities.name: Garden of Dreams
activities.description: Restored garden in the Kaiser Mahal complex with neo-classical pavilions, fountains and a Chinese Moon Gate, described as a quiet oasis.

access.details: The source does not establish step-free entry, internal routes, gradients or seating.

activities.familyNotes: Quiet is NTB's description, not a measured crowd level.
limitations: Hours and fees were not verified.

activities.name: Swayambhunath Stupa
activities.description: One of Nepal's holiest Buddhist stupas on a hillock with shrines and monasteries and a panoramic view of the valley.

access.details: NTB says the main approach is exceedingly steep stone steps, but a motor road goes almost to the top, followed by a short walk. That last stretch is not described as step-free.

activities.familyNotes: Avoid the stone steps with elders; the road route still ends in a short walk of unknown gradient.
limitations: Largest crowds are expected on Buddha's birthday, usually in May, per NTB.
Fees and hours were not verified.

activities.name: Pashupatinath Temple
activities.area: 5 km east of the city centre, Bagmati River
activities.description: Nepal's most revered Hindu temple on the Bagmati River; non-Hindus may view from terraces across the river.

access.details: NTB says taxis or microbuses drop visitors at Gaushala, followed by a short walk of unknown gradient.

activities.familyNotes: Leather items and photography are not allowed inside per NTB; festival days are very crowded.
limitations: NTB says the main complex is open only to Hindus.
Fees were not verified for this pass.

activities.name: Kirtipur
activities.description: Ancient Newar hill town with paved streets, red-brick houses, temple squares, the Chilamchu Stupa and Bagh Bhairab Temple, and Newari eateries.

access.details: NTB calls it a little hill town on a ridge; street gradients are not described.

activities.familyNotes: A less-visited option outside the city; slopes in a hill town may tire elders.
limitations: NTB lists it about 30 minutes from Kathmandu; this is travel time, not walking time.
